parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry is_test=true and reside in the same test file, Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/PlayerControllerBehaviorTests.swift. The two methods — PlayerControllerBehaviorTests.multipleStopCallsAreIdempotent (line 132) and StopBehaviorTests.stopIsIdempotent (line 214) — are test fixtures that verify idempotency of stop behaviour from different test-class perspectives. Although the Jaccard similarity is high (0.778), the near-duplication is intentional: each test class exercises the same invariant in its own behavioural context, and merging them would conflate distinct test-suite responsibilities and obscure which behaviour group is under test.
